_comment: Partner slot on /whats-on/. Single card between Signature and Seasonal sections. Set enabled to true and fill the fields to ship. Renders nothing when enabled is false. Labelling is mandatory and, since PI-021, enforced: PartnerSlot.astro refuses to build an enabled slot whose label does not read as a paid disclosure. The destination is named sponsoredUrl, not url, so scripts/audit-commercial-firewall.mjs can see that this surface is commercial - see project_pi_advertising_pivot memory note.
label: Sponsored
